review_candidates.title: Enterprise Risk Advisor
review_candidates.description: Job Details Description About Archer A new regulatory change lands somewhere in the world every six minutes, and agentic AI is outpacing most teams' ability to govern it. At Archer, we help the enterprises powering the global economy turn that pressure into an advantage. Mandates like the EU AI Act and the SEC cybersecurity disclosure rules are driving the most significant GRC buying cycle we have seen in years. That demand is why we are growing this team. This is hard work that matters. Our customers span energy, utilities, financial services, pharmaceuticals, and the public institutions communities depend on. People choose Archer because they get to partner with the most trusted brands in the world, on work that protects the customers and communities those brands serve. If that sounds like your kind of work, let's chat. The Role The Enterprise Risk Advisor supports the effective operation of Archer’s Enterprise Risk Management and Third Party Risk Management activities. The role provides practical, hands‑on support to risk processes, systems, and reporting, ensuring timely, accurate, and consistent execution of risk oversight activities across the business. The role has a strong focus on operational excellence, data quality, and stakeholder support, acting as a key enabler for both internal risk teams and the wider business. What You’ll Do Reporting & Management Information Own the ISRM reporting methodology, standards, governance, and reporting calendar. Produce monthly management information (MI) packs and executive reporting. Develop reporting and dashboards covering TPRM, findings, actions, risks, controls, and operational performance. Ensure reporting is accurate, timely, consistent, and decision-useful. Risk Analysis & Insight Analyze risk, TPRM, findings, actions, and operational data to identify trends, themes, emerging risks, and process weaknesses. Perform root-cause, thematic, concentration risk, and exception analysis. Provide management insight and recommendations based on data-driven findings. Support proactive identification of issues requiring escalation or intervention. Governance, Oversight & Assurance Maintain oversight of findings, remediation actions, exceptions, and risk treatment activities. Support audit, assurance, and ISO-related activities, including evidence management and action tracking. Monitor compliance with risk governance requirements and reporting obligations. Support escalation of overdue, high-risk, or systemic issues. Risk Operations & Systems Management Provide operational administration and support for Archer GRC. Maintain risk, control, issue, finding, and action data quality. Manage operational workflows, ticket queues, and JIRA activity. Support data integrity, process efficiency, and audit readiness across risk processes. Coordination & Operational Risk Support Produce and maintain TPRM reporting and operational metrics. Triage and coordinate risk escalations. Track assessment progress, remediation activities, and risk acceptance decisions. Act as a coordination analyst for the Enterprise Risk and Compliance function What You Bring Experience working in an enterprise risk or operational risk environment Solid analytical skills, with the ability to interpret risk and operational data and turn it into clear management information, trends and insights. Experience producing management reporting and dashboards. Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated focus on data quality, completeness, accuracy, and consistency. Good understanding of risk management principles, including risk identification, assessment, treatment, acceptance, escalation, and monitoring. Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workflows, actions, deadlines, and stakeholder requests at the same time. Confidence working with stakeholders across different functions and levels of seniority, including Security, Engineering, Legal, Procurement, Finance and Go To Market. A practical, problem-solving mindset, with the ability to identify process weaknesses and opportunities to improve Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present risk information in a clear, concise, and decision-useful way. Even Better If You Have Experience using Archer GRC particularly for risk, control, issue, findings, or action management. Experience with reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI and Excel, including building or maintaining dashboards and management reporting. Experience working with JIRA or similar workflow/ticket-management tools. Exposure to ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, NIST, or other recognised security and risk frameworks. Experience supporting internal or external audits, certification activities, assurance reviews, or evidence collection. Experience performing trend, thematic, root-cause, exception, or concentration-risk analysis. Experience working in a SaaS, technology or regulated environment. Experience improving or standardising risk processes, reporting methodologies, data structures, or governance workflows. review_candidates.title: Customer Engineering Support (CES) – Specialist - Mining & Beyond Road
review_candidates.description: 1. Role Overview: The CES Specialist is a field-based technical role in Customer Engineering Support (CES) which falls in the Quality Domain of Michelin. The Specialist covers five areas: capturing how our products are used, giving technical advice, market surveillance, claim management and field surveys. 2. Key Responsibilities: Capture Usage: Collect data in the field on how our products and associated services are used and how they perform, in order to improve our offer and identify risks. Give Advice: Provide technical support to customers, internal stakeholders and the Marketing & Sales teams, to promote the benefits our products and services bring to customers, add technical value and reduce risk. Market Surveillance: Monitor the market and the field performance of our products and services against the competition. Claim Management: Help resolve customer complaints, balancing customer focus with protecting the company. If formally delegated, handle product liability matters and minor disputes involving tyres and associated services, under the responsibility of the Product Liability Correspondent. Field Surveys: Depending on the product domain, find suitable customer fleets, agree terms, and set up and follow field surveys. The aim is to improve the quality of our products and services and to manage remaining risks on new technologies or designs. 3. Key Expected Results Field usage and performance studies defined, led and carried out (for example end-of-life tyre examinations, usage characterization and performance measurement plans), with summary reports on the results, including for current market products and field surveys. Alert reports sent to the central Risk Analysis team. Reports on minor litigation cases, where delegated and outside North America. Technical advice and training for the sales force and for external customers. Technical demonstrations at commercial product launch events. On-the-job training and tutoring for new CES team members.

Competența și pasiunea ta vor fi esențiale pentru atingerea și depășirea obiectivelor de vânzări, crescând astfel cota de piață pe care o avem pe diferite piețe și segmente. review_candidates.title: Billing & Revenue Specialist | Legal Tech Scale-up
review_candidates.description: Some industries matter beyond their own business. Law is one of them. That's why the best legal tech shouldn't only end up at the biggest firms. We want to put it in the hands of every legal professional, from global firms to small practices and in-house teams. If only a few get the good tools, the promise of the law falls apart. It's a big ambition, and we're just getting started. Legal professionals lose a big part of their week hunting for the right source, checking it's still good law and redoing work that's already been done. We want to take that friction away, so legal teams can spend their time on people, ethics and work that matters. That's what Saga is built for. Founded in Europe for the legal profession, we connect to local legal sources across multiple jurisdictions and work in 12 languages. In 2 years we've grown to 90+ people and 6,000+ users in 25 countries. We lead the market in Norway and the Netherlands, and we're now expanding across Europe. Your role as Billing & Revenue Specialist As our Billing & Revenue Specialist, you'll look after the accuracy of Saga's customer, billing and revenue data - from contracts and subscriptions to invoices and deferred revenue. Many of our revenue processes aren't fully set up yet, so part of the job is building them: documenting how things work, fixing mismatches between systems and finding where automation can help. You'll join a finance team of three and work closely with Customer Success and Sales. Your work keeps billing running smoothly for our customers and gives Finance revenue figures it can trust every month. What you’ll be doing Run day-to-day billing and invoicing, keeping customer records, contracts and subscriptions accurate in our billing systems. When a billing issue comes up, you'll be the one who sorts it out. Own the Chargebee system and its integrations being the single point of contact internally and externally for all queries. Prepare and maintain our deferred revenue calculations and supporting schedules. You'll also run month-end close with accurate revenue figures, MRR checks and reporting on our revenue metrics. Reconcile customer, subscription and billing data between our systems, including our accounting systems, and get to the bottom of it when the numbers don't match. Follow up on overdue invoices and working with Customer Success and Sales team to lower the debtor receivable days ratio. Document and improve our revenue processes, spotting opportunities for automation and use of AI, and putting them into practice together with Finance and Operations. What you bring to our team 3+ years or equivalent experience in Billing Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance Operations or a similar role. Hands-on experience with billing and invoicing processes and with customer, billing or accounting systems. You're comfortable working with financial data in spreadsheets, particularly Excel, and you enjoy digging into a problem until you understand what's behind it. Careful attention to detail and good organisation, so invoices, schedules and reconciliations stay accurate month after month. Clear, friendly communication about financial matters, and professional working proficiency in English. You like taking a task from start to finish, and you're curious about how our processes could work better. Strong interest in automating workflows and use of AI in financial space. Why join Saga Legal Saga is a fast-growing legal innovation company on a mission to remove the friction between legal expertise and real-world impact - and we're just getting started. We're a team of lawyers, engineers, and builders spread across multiple countries and continents, bringing a genuinely international perspective to everything we do. If you thrive in a flat, high-ownership environment where you're building from the ground up and the pace is real, this is the place for you. We also offer: This role is open in Amsterdam or Oslo . Compensation and benefits are aligned with local market standards for each location Amsterdam: EUR 50,000 - 65,000, all inclusive Oslo: NOK 640,000 - 790,000 A range of benefits that support you in your role: paid vacation days, IT equipment, travel reimbursement Direct impact from day one: your work helps build Saga’s finance policies and structures Space to experiment and build, with the support to make it work A fully remote setup with flexibility to work from home and our hubs in Amsterdam or Oslo Be part of a team of legal professionals building the future of legal work An English-first, international working environment with strong Norwegian roots and a growing European presence If this sounds like the kind of work you want to own, we'd love to meet you.
